recreation_brief:
1. Create a blank slide and set the background fill to light gray (#F0F0F0).
2. Insert a rectangle with no fill and a thin red outline (#C00000, ~1.5-2pt) covering the full slide area to act as a border.
3. Add a centered text box in the upper-middle area (around 35% from top). Type 'Update Weights of' on line 1 and 'Output Layer' on line 2. Format as bold, dark red (#C00000), serif font, approximately 40pt.
4. Add a second centered text box below the title (around 60% from top). Type '( Weights from previous layer to output layer)'. Format as italic, dark blue (#0000CC), serif font, approximately 28pt. Apply underline formatting only to the words 'previous layer' and 'output layer'.
5. Add a small oval shape in the top-right corner. Fill it pale yellow (#FFFF99) with no outline. Add the number '6' centered inside it in a small dark font (~14pt).
6. Ensure all elements are centered horizontally except the corner badge.
